project_type: Counter agent-commerce platform: pnpm workspace monorepo (36 projects), TypeScript ESM. 3 backend services (apps/control-plane-api, apps/worker, apps/agent-runtime) deploy to Fly.io via a shared root Dockerfile; 4 Next.js consoles deploy to Vercel.
build_system: pnpm 9.15.4 workspaces. Root build = `pnpm -r --if-present run build`. Each package/app build script is currently `tsc -p tsconfig.json`. tsconfig.base.json already sets composite:true. NODE SETUP REQUIRED at start of every bash command: `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22`.
test_framework: vitest 3.0.7. Each package/app has `test`: `vitest run`. Root `pnpm test` = `pnpm -r --if-present run test`. Vitest uses esbuild transform (NO tsc typecheck at test time), so excluding test files from the tsc BUILD config does NOT affect `pnpm test`. Tests import cross-package symbols via `@counter/*` which resolve to built `dist/index.js`, so dist must exist before running tests (normal build-then-test workflow).
verification_instructions: From a CLEAN state: (1) `find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path './node_modules/*' -delete && rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist`. (2) `pnpm build` must pass. (3) `pnpm test` must pass (baseline ~2811 passing). (4) `pnpm depcruise` must pass. (5) Build all 3 backend images the exact Fly way: `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/control-plane-api -t t-cpa .`, same for apps/worker (t-worker) and apps/agent-runtime (t-agent); each must succeed, contain a runnable dist entrypoint, and NOT build the 4 Next.js consoles.
snapshot_or_generated_files: TypeScript build outputs: apps/*/dist, packages/*/dist, and *.tsbuildinfo files (gitignored). Regenerate with `pnpm build`. No committed snapshots.
setup_instructions: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Deps already installed in sandbox.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Docker is available as `podman` 5.2.3 (use `podman build` to reproduce the Fly build exactly). CRITICAL SANDBOX FILE BUG: fs_write/str_replace/read_file operate on a per-turn overlay that diverges from the real disk seen by git/pnpm/tsc/podman. ALL file edits MUST be done via bash (python3 heredoc or `cat <<'EOF'`) and verified with `git diff`/`cat` via bash before building. `tsc -b` trusts *.tsbuildinfo over dist presence, so ALWAYS delete *.tsbuildinfo AND dist together when cleaning.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT git add/commit/push (orchestrator publishes). Keep changes minimal and idiomatic. Preserve the OOM fix: backend Docker image must NOT build the 4 Next.js consoles. Do not change deployed limits, spend-ledger, worker money-seam, or Transactions read-model behavior. Do not revert the Next apps' transpilePackages/ignoreBuildErrors/ignoreDuringBuilds settings.
key_patterns: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED LIVE: workspace deps ARE declared (workspace:0.1.0) in every backend package.json, but `pnpm -r run build` runs package builds IN PARALLEL and does not wait for a dependency's dist/*.d.ts to be emitted before a dependent starts `tsc -p`, so dependents fail with TS2307 'Cannot find module @counter/domain'. A clean Docker layer always loses this race. FIX (validated by spikes): TypeScript PROJECT REFERENCES + `tsc -b`. `tsc -b <leaf>` builds the entire referenced closure in correct topological order from clean. PRECEDENT EXISTS: packages/wallet-domain, wallet-contracts, wallet-application and apps/local-mcp ALREADY have references arrays, but their build scripts are still `tsc -p` (which IGNORES references), so those references are currently inert. Second issue: package/app tsconfigs use include:[src] with no test exclusion, so tsc compiles *.test.ts / *.integration.test.ts, producing TS7006 implicit-any errors from test files in prod builds. FIX (validated): add a per-package tsconfig.build.json extending the standard tsconfig, adding exclude [**/*.test.ts, **/*.integration.test.ts], a distinct tsBuildInfoFile, and references pointing to each dependency's tsconfig.build.json; set build script to `tsc -b tsconfig.build.json`. Spike confirmed no test files are emitted and the closure builds in order.
relevant_files: Dockerfile (root; builds target via pnpm --filter ./${BUILD_TARGET}... run build - path filter ./apps/x... selects ONLY the app, not deps; CMD uses dist/main.js)
fly.worker.toml (BUILD_TARGET=apps/worker; process runs node apps/worker/dist/index.js - note index.js not main.js)
packages/domain/tsconfig.json (leaf, no deps - reference target of nearly everything)
apps/worker/tsconfig.json, apps/agent-runtime/tsconfig.json, apps/control-plane-api/tsconfig.json (backend app tsconfigs to give references + build variants)
